description: This source file defines the 'Field' class in the OpenMRS project, representing a metadata entity with various properties such as field type, concept, table name, attribute name, default value, and associated answers. It includes getter and setter methods, constructors, and methods to manage related answers.

classes.name: Field
classes.description: Represents a metadata field with various attributes and relationships to other entities such as FieldType and Concept. Extends BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata and includes methods for managing its properties and associated answers.

methods.name: getFieldId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the field.

methods.name: setFieldId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the field.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Returns the type of the field.

methods.name: setFieldType
methods.description: Sets the type of the field.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept associated with the field.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept associated with the field.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the database table name for the field.

methods.name: setTableName
methods.description: Sets the database table name for the field.

methods.name: getAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the attribute name of the field.

methods.name: setAttributeName
methods.description: Sets the attribute name of the field.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the field.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the field.

methods.name: isSelectMultiple
methods.description: Deprecated method; returns whether multiple selections are allowed.

methods.name: getSelectMultiple
methods.description: Returns whether multiple selections are allowed.

methods.name: setSelectMultiple
methods.description: Sets whether multiple selections are allowed.

methods.name: getAnswers
methods.description: Returns the set of answers associated with the field.

methods.name: setAnswers
methods.description: Sets the answers associated with the field.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Adds a FieldAnswer to the set of answers.

methods.name: removeAnswer
methods.description: Removes a FieldAnswer from the set of answers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier (fieldId) of the field, overriding OpenmrsObject method.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier (fieldId) of the field, overriding OpenmrsObject method.
